headline: President Trump signed an executive order creating the "Great American Recovery Initiative" to address addiction.
what_it_does: This executive order sets up a federal effort called the Great American Recovery Initiative focused on addiction. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, agencies involved, programs, and funding are not known from the available information.

who_it_affects.group: People struggling with addiction and their families
who_it_affects.how: The initiative is aimed at addiction, but the specific services or changes for them are not described in the available information.
Agencies will likely be directed to carry out parts of the initiative, though which ones and what tasks are not stated.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 29, 2026; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
